subject: Alphanumeric literals
notes: cite.py --check 8.3.3.2.3 "shall be in the same coded character set representation as the opening quotation symbol" OK. The lexer recognizes exactly two delimiter code points (U+0022, U+0027) and the doubled pair is written as the same code point as the opener in STR_BODY, so a pair in a different representation (e.g. U+FF02 FULLWIDTH QUOTATION MARK) is never taken as a doubled delimiter -- it is ordinary content. Satisfied by construction; no spec-derived test isolates it. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 2014, 2023 (Annex E itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and lists no change to 8.3.3.2, so the rule stands in both; the 1985/2002 edge is NOT derivable in-repo -- no 2002 or 1985 text is held)
